Proposition
[Bochner formula for closed $1$-forms]

Source: petersen:page-0351 ↗ prop:pet-ch9-vector-field-1form-duality 1. ch9:9.2.2Suppose $ abla X$ is symmetric, or equivalently $X^ lat $ is closed. Put $f= frac 12|X|^2$ and choose a local potential $X= abla u$ near $p$. At $p$ one has

  1. $ abla f= abla _XX$.

  2. $\operatorname {Hess}f(V,V)=\operatorname {Hess}^2u(V,V)+( abla _X\operatorname {Hess}u)(V,V)+R(V,X,X,V) =| abla _VX|^2+g( abla ^2_XX,V)+R(V,X,X,V)$.

  3. $\Delta f=|\operatorname {Hess}u|^2+D_X\Delta u+\operatorname {Ric}(X,X) =| abla X|^2+D_X\operatorname {div}X+\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)$.

Proof

↗ prop:pet-ch9-bochner-formula-1forms \sketch Symmetry of $ abla X$ gives $g( abla f,V)=g( abla _VX,X)=g( abla _XX,V)$. Differentiate this identity once more, commute the two covariant derivatives, and use $X= abla u$ to obtain the Hessian formula. Tracing in a frame parallel along $X$ at the point of evaluation gives $\Delta f=| abla X|^2+D_X\operatorname {div}X+\operatorname {Ric}(X,X)$.

□
